claims: A'ja Wilson signed a three-year $5 million fully guaranteed supermax contract extension with the Las Vegas Aces in April 2026.
A'ja Wilson's contract extension makes her the highest-paid player in WNBA history.
A'ja Wilson's contract extension begins in 2026.
A'ja Wilson's contract extension keeps her with the Las Vegas Aces through 2028.
A'ja Wilson is a four-time MVP.
A'ja Wilson's contract extension has a total value of $5 million and is fully guaranteed.
A'ja Wilson's contract extension is a 3-year supermax extension covering 2026-2028.
The annual salary in A'ja Wilson's contract extension begins at roughly 1.4-1.5 million.
A'ja Wilson's contract extension surpasses the previous league high of the 3.75 million deal signed by Ezi Magbegor.
A'ja Wilson's contract extension is the richest contract in WNBA history.
A'ja Wilson's contract extension aligns her with teammates Jackie Young and Chelsea Gray.
A'ja Wilson has previously won championships with the Las Vegas Aces.
A'ja Wilson has previously won MVPs with the Las Vegas Aces franchise
